title: Ashbury Rewards Earning on Room Reservations by Rate Plan and Channel
content:
What a Room Reservations stay earns in Ashbury Rewards depends on the rate plan and on the channel the reservation was booked through. The schedule shows, per plan, whether the stay earns base points, the elite tier bonus on top of base points and elite night credits, whether a reservation booked through an online travel agency or through a travel agency's global distribution system earns, and whether elite on-property benefits are honoured on an online travel agency reservation.

| Rate plan | Base points | Elite tier bonus | Elite night credits | Earns when booked through an online travel agency | Earns when booked by a travel agency through a global distribution system | Elite on-property benefits on an online travel agency booking |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Advance Purchase Non-Refundable Rate | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | No | No |
| Semi-Flexible Saver Rate | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | No | No |
| Flexible Rate | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | Yes | No |
| Member Flexible Rate | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | No | No |
| Bed & Breakfast Package Rate | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | No | No |
| Corporate Negotiated Rate | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | Yes | No |
| Group Block Rate | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | No | No |
| Reward Night Rate | No | No | Yes | No | No | No |

## Points of reading

- **Channel columns.** "Earns" in the two travel-agency columns means the reservation earns points and night credits when booked through that channel. No plan earns when booked through an online travel agency, and no plan honours elite on-property benefits on an online travel agency booking. Only the Flexible Rate and the Corporate Negotiated Rate earn when booked by a travel agency through a global distribution system.
- **Reward Night Rate.** A Reward Night Rate stay earns no base points and no elite bonus, but its nights are credited as elite night credits.
- **Every other plan** earns base points, the elite bonus and elite night credits when booked directly.
